empty_program: Nothing here yet! This road goes straight and then bends. Start with the straight part -- add 'move forward' cards first.
unbalanced_block: Every block card you open needs its matching end card underneath it. Look down your stack for one that never got closed.
infinite_loop: Your program went round and round and never stopped. A 'while not at goal' only ends when you actually reach the goal -- check yours can get there.
wrong_order: All the right cards, just not quite in order! Walk the road in your head, step by step -- when exactly does it bend?
